answer_1.quote: ToM-SSI is formulated as a visual-text question answering task and is thus inherently multimodal.
answer_1.outputs: The models generate answers to percept, belief, and intention questions in a situated social interaction setting, based on visual and textual input.

answer_2.quote: For each task, we measured models' accuracy on percept (P), belief (B), and intention (I) questions. We then computed two scores: the PB score, which requires correctly answering percept and belief questions (P ∧ B), and the PBI score, which requires correctly answering all three question types (P ∧ B ∧ I).

answer_4.quote: We recruited 20 human participants and asked them to answer 45 questions, equally split between tasks. Participants were shown the same prompt as the models.
answer_4.guideline: Participants were informed about their task, the duration of the experiment, and that their responses would be kept anonymous and used solely for research purposes. They then went through a guided example that explains the rules of social interactions... Between tasks, participants had to answer additional attention-check questions to ensure their attentiveness.
